name: Norwegian Refugee Council
summary: A Norwegian humanitarian foundation working with people displaced by conflict and disaster in about 40 countries: shelter, water and sanitation, education, legal assistance, protection, cash and (until 2027) food security, mostly funded by governments and the UN; it also runs NORCAP, a roster of experts seconded to UN agencies and governments, the Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre, and global advocacy on humanitarian access and funding. Modelled on its audited 2025 accounts.

spending.source: https://www.flyktninghjelpen.no/globalassets/pdf/annual-accounts/2025/nrc-annual-accounts-2025_130826.pdf (Annual Accounts 2025, audited, year to 31 December 2025, note 5 p. 6: direct costs on humanitarian activities NOK 7,934,708 thousand of total costs NOK 8,700,531 thousand; excludes project support NOK 470,605 thousand, administration NOK 71,003 thousand and fundraising NOK 224,215 thousand. Kroner converted at $0.0962279 a krone, the IRS's 2025 yearly average (facts/fx.json usd_per_nok_2025).)
